verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an accounting SaaS with an API, MCP and CLI, but nothing in the evidence documents batch or bulk endpoints or multi-item actions. The contacts docs describe only single-item get, create and update, plus list filtering and duplicate detection, which are adjacent features and not bulk operations. The MCP, CLI and API channels are building blocks a user could script loops with, not a bulk capability of the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
